ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's arrival-button record to Ryde account review for abuse of the "I'm Here" button; no flag_account chain required beyond that review path.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat consists only of arrival/where-are-you messages and a cancellation notice; no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation in the complaint, chat or driver statement. safety_concern = none.

Facts computed from the record: pickup = Woodlands Civic Centre (1.436, 103.7865). The driver pressed "I'm Here" at 22:37:20 (tl-here). The thinned GPS trace (5 s grid, every 6th sample) puts the driver at 1.444959, 103.785731 at 22:37:00 and stationary at 1.444957, 103.785725 from 22:37:30 through cancellation at 22:42:00. The distance from that stationary position to the pickup point is ~0.997–1.0 km (≈9.0e-3° latitude ≈ 1.0 km north, with negligible longitude offset). So at the moment of the tap and throughout the wait the driver was roughly 1.0 km from the pickup point — far outside any 200 m arrival radius (G2 data-layer parameter). This matches the rider's chat at 22:38:20 ("I'm at the pickup point, no car here").

NS-1 requires all of (i) arrival tap, (ii) GPS within the pickup radius at the tap, and (iii) a continuous >3-minute wait inside that radius. Iterating the samples 22:37:30 → 22:42:00 the driver is stationary near 1.44496, 103.78572 the whole time, i.e. still ~1.0 km away, so (ii) fails (1,000 m > 200 m) and (iii) also fails (0 s within 200 m after the tap). NS-1 is therefore not satisfied, so by NS-0/NS-1/NS-2 the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee does not stand and must be refunded in full to the rider. The samples are dense (30 s apart, no gap), so no G12 gap issue arises. The driver's statement that he waited "at the pickup" is contradicted by the GPS record, and under the procedure rule system records (gps/timeline) override statements.

Amount: the charged cancellation fee is fare.cancellation_fee = $6.61 → refund_full $6.61, issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7 (the dispute was filed 2026-09-20, the same day as the trip, well within the 30-day window). Because the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS shows him ~1 km from the pickup point, the RD-6/NS-2 account-review limb is triggered; I record that as an account-review recommendation rather than a structured flag, since this is a rider-side refund under NS-1/NS-2 rather than an RD-2 detour refund or an RD-1 violation finding.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup point. The GPS trace shows him stationary at ~1.444957, 103.785725 from 22:37:30 to 22:42:00, about 1.0 km from the pickup point (1.436, 103.7865), and ~1.0 km away at the tap at 22:37:20. System records override the statement; both the 'at the pickup point' and 'waited at the pickup' elements fail.
No-show under NS-1 fails on elements (ii) and (iii): the driver was never within the pickup radius at the tap or during the wait, so no $6.61 cancellation fee can be charged to the rider.
